context_requirements: Expression of TBXA2R (thromboxane A2 receptor) on the cell surface
Presence of endogenous thromboxane/prostanoid tone or an agonist-driven state
Intact downstream Gq/11-Ca2+ and/or Rho-ROCK signaling
Mesangial, fibroblast, endothelial, or smooth-muscle-like phenotype for matrix/fibrotic readouts
falsifiers: No change in any of the listed late genes at 24 h in any of the nine lines
A clear, strong transcriptional response at 6 h in lines lacking TBXA2R expression
Coordinate upregulation of generic proliferation or cell-cycle genes at 24 h
Dose-dependent changes that are identical in TBXA2R-null and TBXA2R-positive lines

evidence.supports: Thromboxane analogues increase extracellular matrix protein mRNA (fibronectin, laminin, type IV collagen) in mesangial and F9 cells, and this is inhibited by a thromboxane-receptor antagonist.
